items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: The big drum was Buddy Rich and Max Roach. I would ask them, you know, they don't know they're busy, how did you do it?

ctx.x: You know. Because these guys, like I said, that was just playing the role. Maybe they couldn't swing, but they can play a role. And if you're playing the role today, you play that role when somebody was playing back and blah, blah, blah. Yeah, right. Just keep that, no attitudes is what I'm trying to say. Just learn to play your instrument, do the best that you can, and if you can help somebody with it, help somebody come to you and say, how do you do this? You know, it's going to be $50 for me to show you.…
If somebody doesn't know anything about drums, and they just, you know, they've got a set of drums, and you sat them down, what's the first thing you're going to tell them about the drums?
